headline: Sensex and Nifty trade volatile as PSU bank gains offset losses in private banking majors like Axis and HDFC.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Buying interest in PSU banks like PNB and SBI provides a cushion against broader market declines.
Heavyweight private banks including Axis Bank and HDFC Bank are under pressure following earnings reports.
Elevated crude oil prices and cautious global sentiment are dampening investor enthusiasm.
Significant FII outflows over the past decade and upcoming US tech earnings create a cautious atmosphere.
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 is hovering around the 23,000-23,150 level amid high intraday volatility.
PNB shares surged 6% while Axis Bank fell 4%, highlighting a divergence between PSU and private banks.
Indian stock markets will remain closed on Tuesday, October 20, in observance of the Dussehra holiday.
The India VIX has risen by 2.6%, reflecting increased market uncertainty and risk perception.
summary: The Indian market is witnessing volatility as Nifty holds near 23,100, supported by a rally in PSU banks. Private lenders like Axis Bank and HDFC Bank are weighing on indices, while global cues remain mixed. Markets will remain closed tomorrow for Dussehra.
